title: The Perfect Ledger
author: H. M. Lockridge
blurb: Sebastian Dravenmoor, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
